Reference-counted helper for GBitmapSequence with automatic timer scheduling

Provides a small ref-wrapper around GBitmapSequence that owns or wraps the C sequence and offers a convenient scheduleNextFrame helper which advances frames and registers an app timer to continue playback.

ConstructorsBasic operationsInternal timer callback trampolineAutomatic scheduling helperUsage example in documentation
